fishing: WHEN: early/moving tides (solunar ~7-9a / 7-9p). PASSES-BEACH: snook C&R, redfish, jacks, pompano Stump/Manasota. LEMON BAY: redfish schools, snook mangroves/docks, mangrove snapper. NEARSHORE: mangrove/lane snapper, gag open. Baits: live shrimp, pinfish, soft plastics, pilchards.
redtide: FWC: K. brevis background in 1 Sarasota sample past week; not observed elsewhere SWFL.
bacteria: Englewood Beach GOOD (10 CFU); Charlotte sites clear.
